shows.title: The Unlikely Cook with Awkwafina
shows.plot_overview: Nora Lum aka Awkwafina embarks on a deeply personal cross-country journey as she explores contemporary Asian American cuisine, starting with her family's remarkable legacy.

shows.title: Freeheld
shows.plot_overview: New Jersey car mechanic Stacie Andree and her police detective girlfriend Laurel Hester both battle to secure Hester's pension benefits after she was diagnosed with a terminal illness.

shows.title: The Last Time We Are Kids
shows.plot_overview:
Noah is an ordinary student—or so he believes. What he doesn’t know is that he carries hidden powers unlike anything the world has ever seen. When a terrifying monster threatens humanity, Noah and his friends are thrown into an unexpected adventure.

To save their world, the group must travel into a mysterious alternate realm where danger lurks behind every shadow.
